select * from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over() rownum, fci.CCY ccy, facr.CAWLBACK_RULE coveringWay, facr.CAWLBACK_TYPE coveringForm, fca.ACCR_STR_DATE covCycleStartDate, fca.ACCR_END_DATE covCycleEndDate from FIN_CASH_INFO fci inner join FIN_CLAWBACK_CALC_RULE facr on facr.CASH_ID=fci.CASH_ID
inner join FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE fca on fca.CASH_ID=fci.CASH_ID where 1=1 and fci.CASH_TYPE_1=#{CASH_TYPE_1_06} and fci.CASH_TYPE_2=#{CASH_TYPE_2_C11} and fci.FINPROD_TYPE=#{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} and facr.CAWLBACK_TYPE = #{ANAPLEROTIC_TYPE_01} and fca.ACCR_END_DATE <= to_date(#{dates}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and fci.FINPROD_ID=#{prodId}
Order by fca.ACCR_END_DATE desc ) where rownum=1
